Batch 7: effectiveness + consented UX capture behind preprod flag
rollback: Per-batch feature flags disable writers; retain append-only data
Hunter shadow default; disable flag → no emission
Contract versions additive; deprecate via version bump
Append-only stores; rollback = disable writers + keep data
